title: QUANTITATIVE METHODS FOR SYSTEM ANALYSIS AND IMPROVEMENT
description: Analyze and improve operational systems through the application of statistical inference methods and basic empirical model development. Hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, tolerance interval, bootstrap confidence intervals, and basic linear regression are applied to industrial engineering applications.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: IE 255 or (ST 314 and ME 203).
A minimum grade of C is required in IE 255, ST 314 and ME 203.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
